correctness.rationale: The graph is precisely the Cayley model on Z4² with degree six and its complement cyclic Latin-square model. Every independent 4-set is among 4 rows,4 columns,4 cyclic symbols,4 parity blocks; checking all C(16,4)=1820 and C(16,5)=4368 possibilities proves maximum independence number 4 and exact 16 classes. Enumerating all exact covers yields ten partitions and 10·4!=240 named colourings. Both actual independent source algorithms construct ALL legal one-component two-colour switches, one via component generation and another by 28,680 pairwise recognition, and BFS all 240 starts; they assert 1008 edges, eccentricities 168 at4 and 72 at5, complete distances (1008,5400,13416,8280,576), and quotient three squares with common parity-block vertex. This exhaustive finite certificate supports the entire specific graph claim; inspected exact algorithms, not merely their PASS logs. Independent reexecution of code not performed during this run.
